0022600194.text: The Suns (2-5, 2-2 at home) host the Rockets (7-2, 4-1 on the road... no, 3-1 on the road), who lead the Southwest and sit second in the West. Phoenix is 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, while Houston is coming off a loss, its only one in its last three games. Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) are out for the Suns, and Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are out for the Rockets. The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won all four games against Phoenix in 2025-26, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7.
